section.content: The invention discloses a data acquisition device for artificial intelligent machine learning, which belongs to the technical field of data acquisition and comprises a frame body, wherein a connecting plate is arranged on the lower end surface of the frame body, a driving mechanism is arranged between the connecting plate and the frame body, an acquisition device is arranged in the middle position inside the frame body, and a limiting mechanism is arranged between the acquisition device and the frame body; the limiting mechanism comprises limiting rods, handles, baffles, springs and slots, the slots are formed in the two sides of the inside of the collecting device, the limiting rods are slidably inserted into the two sides of the inside of the frame, the baffles are fixedly connected to the outer surfaces of the limiting rods, the springs are sleeved on the outer portions of the limiting rods and are close to the positions of the baffles, the limiting rods correspond to the positions of the slots, the collecting device is well protected, the positions of the collecting device can be conveniently limited, data information of surrounding environments can be collected in an auxiliary mode, and the using convenience of the collecting device is greatly improved and is practical.

本发明公开了数据采集技术领域的一种人工智能机器学习的数据采集装置，包括框体，框体的下端面设置有连接板，连接板与框体之间设置有驱动机构，框体的内部中间位置设置有采集装置，采集装置与框体之间设置有限定机构；限定机构包括有限定杆、手柄、挡板、弹簧与插槽，插槽开设在采集装置的内部两侧位置，限定杆滑动插接在框体的内部两侧位置，挡板固定连接在限定杆的外表面，弹簧套接在限定杆的外部靠近挡板的位置，限定杆与插槽的位置对应，对采集装置具有较好的防护作用，且能够方便将其位置进行安装限定，也能够辅助其对周围的环境的数据信息进行采集，大大提高了装置的使用便捷性，较为实用。

Data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learningTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of data acquisition, in particular to a data acquisition device for artificial intelligent machine learning.

Background

The artificial intelligence machine collects data through staff more, then analyze in the logic operation mechanism in the artificial intelligence machine with data transmission again, thereby reach the effect of study, current data acquisition equipment, its inside is provided with image acquisition memory cell and sound collection unit, shoot the thing that needs to gather through the camera on its upper portion, then transfer the picture to image acquisition memory cell, and through the recording port of its lower part, can transfer the sound that the outside was transferred to in the sound collection unit, in fact, need carry data acquisition device to open air more, carry sound and image acquisition outdoor.

The invention discloses a data acquisition device for artificial intelligent machine learning, which is characterized in that the existing data acquisition device for artificial intelligent machine learning is difficult to protect in the use process, meanwhile, the acquisition device is inconvenient to connect and position with the use position, the surrounding environment is difficult to acquire information fully, and the use has defects.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, which aims to solve the problems that the data acquisition device is difficult to protect in the use process, and meanwhile, the acquisition device is inconvenient to connect and position with the use position, so that the information is difficult to fully acquire surrounding environment.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the present invention provides the following technical solutions: the data acquisition device for artificial intelligent machine learning comprises a frame body, wherein a connecting plate is arranged on the lower end face of the frame body, a driving mechanism is arranged between the connecting plate and the frame body, an acquisition device is arranged in the middle of the inside of the frame body, and a limiting mechanism is arranged between the acquisition device and the frame body;

The limiting mechanism comprises limiting rods, handles, baffles, springs and slots, the slots are formed in two inner side positions of the collecting device, the limiting rods are slidably inserted into two inner side positions of the frame body, the baffles are fixedly connected to the outer surfaces of the limiting rods, the springs are sleeved on the outer portions of the limiting rods and close to the baffle, and the limiting rods correspond to the slots.

Preferably, the driving mechanism comprises a motor, a gear, a toothed ring and a bearing, wherein the motor is arranged at the position, close to the frame, of the upper end surface of the connecting plate.

Preferably, the toothed ring is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the frame body, the frame body is connected with the connecting plate through a bearing, the gear is fixedly connected with the output shaft of the motor, and the gear is meshed and connected with the toothed ring.

Preferably, the inner wall both sides position fixedly connected with supporting shoe of framework, the up end fixedly connected with contact pad of supporting shoe, contact pad and collection system's lower terminal surface contact connection.

Preferably, the upper end face of the frame body is provided with a cover body, a hinge is arranged between one end of the cover body and the frame body, and the other end of the cover body is fastened with the frame body.

Preferably, a pressing mechanism is arranged between the cover body and the collecting device and comprises a threaded column, a handle and a pressing plate, and the handle is fixedly connected to the upper end face of the threaded column.

Preferably, the middle position of the upper end surface of the pressing plate is fixedly connected with a fixing column, the fixing column is inserted into the threaded column, and the fixing column is rotationally connected with the threaded column.

Preferably, the lower terminal surface intermediate position of collection system is provided with supporting mechanism, and supporting mechanism is including connecting cylinder, roof, body of rod and damping spring, and the quantity of connecting cylinder is a plurality of, and the size is different, cup joints between a plurality of connecting cylinder, and the bottom passes through damping spring connection between it, and the inside of connecting cylinder is provided with the body of rod, the up end fixedly connected with roof of body of rod, roof and collection system contact.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that: the slot of collection system both sides can slowly remove the position of prescribing a limit to the pole, afterwards can promote the baffle under the effect of spring, and then prescribing a limit to the pole and can peg graft in the inside of slot, prescribe a limit to the position of collection system, this process roof is contacted with collection system's lower terminal surface all the time, can stretch out and draw back separately through damping spring between each connecting cylinder, when need demolish collection system and framework, can outwards pull prescribing a limit to the pole through the handle, and then just can drive the baffle and remove, compress the spring, afterwards prescribe a limit to the pole and just can break away from with the slot, and then just can break away from between collection system and the framework, when using, in order to better collection to surrounding environment, consequently, need driving motor to drive the gear and rotate, and then the gear can drive the framework and rotate, consequently, can drive collection system rotation, have better diversified collection effect to surrounding environment, have better guard action to collection system, and can conveniently install and prescribe a limit to its position, also can assist its big data to surrounding environment to carry out the device, the practicality is convenient.

Of course, it is not necessary for any one product to practice the invention to achieve all of the advantages set forth above at the same time.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present invention, the drawings that are needed for the description of the embodiments will be briefly described below, and it is obvious that the drawings in the following description are only some embodiments of the present invention, and that other drawings may be obtained according to these drawings without inventive effort for a person skilled in the art.

FIG. 1 is a schematic diagram of the overall structure of the present invention;

FIG. 2 is a view of the combination of a restraining bar and a collection device of the present invention;

FIG. 3 is a view showing the combination of the acquisition device and the support block of the present invention;

FIG. 4 is a view showing the combination of the rod body and the damping spring according to the present invention;

Fig. 5 is a view showing the combination of the motor and the gear according to the present invention.

In the drawings, the list of components represented by the various numbers is as follows:

1. a frame; 2. a cover body; 3. a threaded column; 4. pressing the plate; 5. a hinge; 6. a limiting rod; 7. a collection device; 8. a support block; 9. a contact pad; 10. a motor; 11. a gear; 12. a bearing; 13. a toothed ring; 14. a top plate; 15. a connecting cylinder; 16. a connecting plate; 17. a handle; 18. a spring; 19. a baffle; 20. a rod body; 21. damping spring.

Detailed Description

The following description of the embodiments of the present invention will be made clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings, in which it is apparent that the embodiments described are only some embodiments of the present invention, but not all embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be made by those skilled in the art based on the embodiments of the invention without making any inventive effort, are intended to be within the scope of the invention.

Referring to fig. 1 to 5, the present invention provides a technical scheme of a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning: the device comprises a frame body 1, wherein a connecting plate 16 is arranged on the lower end surface of the frame body 1, a driving mechanism is arranged between the connecting plate 16 and the frame body 1, a collecting device 7 is arranged in the middle of the inside of the frame body 1, and a limiting mechanism is arranged between the collecting device 7 and the frame body 1;

The limiting mechanism comprises limiting rods 6, handles 17, baffles 19, springs 18 and slots, the slots are formed in two side positions of the inside of the collecting device 7, the limiting rods 6 are slidably inserted into two side positions of the inside of the frame body 1, the baffles 19 are fixedly connected to the outer surfaces of the limiting rods 6, the springs 18 are sleeved on the outer portions of the limiting rods 6 and close to the positions of the baffles 19, and the limiting rods 6 correspond to the positions of the slots.

The position of the collecting device 7 is limited, the top plate 14 is always contacted with the lower end face of the collecting device 7 in the process, the connecting cylinders 15 can be separated in an extending mode through damping springs 21, when the collecting device 7 and the frame 1 are required to be disassembled, the limiting rod 6 can be pulled outwards through the handle 17, the baffle 19 can be driven to move, the springs 18 are compressed, then the limiting rod 6 can be separated from the slot, the collecting device 7 and the frame 1 can be separated, in use, in order to collect surrounding environment better, the driving mechanism comprises a motor 10, a gear 11, a toothed ring 13 and a bearing 12, the motor 10 is arranged at the position, close to the frame 1, of the upper end face of the connecting plate 16, the toothed ring 13 is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the frame 1, the frame 1 is connected with the connecting plate 16 through the bearing 12, the gear 11 is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the motor 10, and the gear 11 is meshed and connected with the toothed ring 13.

The inner wall both sides position fixedly connected with supporting shoe 8 of framework 1, the up end fixedly connected with contact pad 9 of supporting shoe 8, contact pad 9 and collection system 7's lower terminal surface contact is connected, the up end of framework 1 is provided with lid 2, be provided with hinge 5 between lid 2's one end and the framework 1, the lock joint is provided with pressing mechanism between lid 2's and the collection system 7 between the other end and the framework 1, pressing mechanism is including screw thread post 3, handle and pressing plate 4, handle fixed connection is at screw thread post 3's up end, pressing plate 4's up end intermediate position fixedly connected with fixed column, the fixed column is pegged graft in screw thread post 3's inside, and rotate between fixed column and the screw thread post 3 and be connected.

The lower terminal surface intermediate position of collection system 7 is provided with supporting mechanism, and supporting mechanism is including connecting cylinder 15, roof 14, body of rod 20 and damping spring 21, and the quantity of connecting cylinder 15 is a plurality of, and the size is different, cup joints between a plurality of connecting cylinder 15, and the bottom passes through damping spring 21 between it to be connected, and the inside of connecting cylinder 15 is provided with body of rod 20, and the up end fixedly connected with roof 14 of body of rod 20, roof 14 and collection system 7 contact.

One specific application of this embodiment is: when using intelligent collection device 7, place frame 1 in the position of use, through connecting plate 16 and ground contact, afterwards open lid 2, carry collection device 7 by the inside of frame 1, afterwards, the slot of collection device 7 both sides can slowly remove the position of prescribing a limit to pole 6, afterwards, can promote baffle 19 under the effect of spring 18, and then prescribe a limit to pole 6 can peg graft in the inside of slot, inject collection device 7's position, this process roof 14 is contacted with collection device 7's lower terminal surface all the time, can stretch out and draw back through damping spring 21 between each connecting cylinder 15, when need demolish collection device 7 and frame 1, can outwards stimulate prescribe a limit to pole 6 through handle 17, and then can drive baffle 19 and remove, compress spring 18, afterwards prescribe a limit to pole 6 just can break away from with the slot, and then break away from between collection device 7 and the frame 1, in order to better collection to the surrounding environment, consequently, need driving motor 10 to drive gear 11 and rotate, and then gear 11 can drive the ring 13 and can rotate, thereby the effect that can be more convenient to carry out the collection device around the rotation, the more convenient and the device that can carry out the rotation of the device, the more convenient and the device is provided with the position of the device is convenient, can be used to the circumstances around the collection device is convenient to be rotated, and the device is convenient to be rotated to be provided with the position of the rotation 13.

The product model provided by the invention is only used according to the structural characteristics of the product, the product can be adjusted and modified after being purchased so as to be more matched with and conform to the technical scheme of the invention, the product model is an optimal application technical scheme of the technical scheme, the product model can be replaced and modified according to the required technical parameters, and the product model is well known to a person skilled in the art, so that the person skilled in the art can clearly obtain the corresponding use effect through the technical scheme provided by the invention.

In the description of the present specification, the descriptions of the terms "one embodiment," "example," "specific example," and the like, mean that a particular feature, structure, material, or characteristic described in connection with the embodiment or example is included in at least one embodiment or example of the present invention. In this specification, schematic representations of the above terms do not necessarily refer to the same embodiments or examples. Furthermore, the particular features, structures, materials, or characteristics described may be combined in any suitable manner in any one or more embodiments or examples.

The preferred embodiments of the invention disclosed above are intended only to assist in the explanation of the invention. The preferred embodiments are not exhaustive or to limit the invention to the precise form disclosed. Obviously, many modifications and variations are possible in light of the above teaching. The embodiments were chosen and described in order to best explain the principles of the invention and the practical application, to thereby enable others skilled in the art to best understand and utilize the invention. The invention is limited only by the claims and the full scope and equivalents thereof.
